20:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NHL Hockey
The Dallas Stars host the Boston Bruins in NHL play. Dallas relies on Wyatt Johnston to lead the offense having won three of the last five meetings, while Boston counts on David Pastrnak coming off his three-assist display in their last clash.

22:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NHL Hockey
The Vegas Golden Knights host the Tampa Bay Lightning in NHL regular-season action at T-Mobile Arena. Tampa Bay have won four of their last five meetings between the two teams, including a 6-3 victory at T-Mobile Arena last season.
